## Houston 0.6.19

### New integration: HighLevel

- **Connect HighLevel from the curated integrations list**, so your agents can work with your CRM right away.

### Smoother answers and a steadier board

- **Replies and their follow-up suggestions arrive together**, as one complete answer.
- **Your task board stays accurate**, so a slow refresh no longer undoes a change you just made.

### Fixes and polish

- **Houston reopens properly after an update on Windows.**
- **Moving a workspace between machines is more reliable**, with large transfers no longer running out of time.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
